Package restaurantrush.control

Class HappyHour

java.lang.Object
restaurantrush.control.HappyHour
All Implemented Interfaces:
PriceModifier
public class HappyHour extends Object implements PriceModifier
Happy Hour: a promotion the manager may switch on once per game, at the start of a turn. It lasts for that turn and the next.
  • Orders taken while it is active get 20% off, applied after any VIP discount. The price is locked when the order is taken, so earlier orders are not affected.
  • At the start of each active turn, customers still waiting for a table or for food recover 15 satisfaction (maximum 100).
